[Book in progress]{.status-badge}

*Mortality Analytics: Statistical Methods for Multi-Cause Attribution* is a book project by **Federica Gazzelloni and Sarah Cuschieri**.

## The question behind the book

How can we study mortality when several causes contribute to a death? MASTA explores statistical methods for multi-cause attribution and the interpretation of mortality data.

The project connects mortality analysis with questions about how deaths are recorded, how causes relate to one another, and what statistical methods can help us understand those relationships.

## Current stage

The book is in development. Further details and resources will be shared as the work progresses.
